hero.paragraph: I-HydroLedger inika iindawo zokuhlala iinkcukacha zokusetyenziswa kwamanzi ngexesha lokwenyani, ukubalwa kweendleko ezabelwanayo ngokucacileyo, kunye nezilumkiso zokuqala zokuvuza — konke oku kwi-dashboard enye.

trustBar.label: Ithetshwe ngamaqela alawulayo aqhubela phambili eendawo zokuhlala ezininzi

features.paragraph: Valelisa kwindlela yakudala yokuhlawula amanzi ngokulinganayo. I-HydroLedger ikhuthaza ulingano ngomlinganiselo ochanekileyo kunye ne-automation ekrelekrele.

items.title: Ubungqina bamanzi bexesha lokwenyani
items.text: Linganisela ukusetyenziswa kwamanzi okuchanekileyo, umzuzu ngomzuzu kwiiyunithi ngazinye endaweni yokuthemba uqikelelo lwakudala.

items.title: Ukubalwa kweendleko zoluntu okuzenzekelayo
items.text: Ukwenziwa kwee-invoice ezisiwa ngqo kubahlali ngokusekelwe ekusebenziseni kwabo. Susa iindleko zolawulo lokubala ngexesha elifutshane.

items.title: Izilumkiso zokufumanisa ukuvuza kwangethuba
items.text: Izilumkiso ezizenzekelayo ezikwazisa ngoko nangoko malunga nemiqondiso yokuqukuqela okungaqhelekanga kwaye ubambe umonakalo omkhulu wamanzi kwimizuzu nje, hayi iinyanga.

items.title: Ukwabiwa kweendleko ngokufanelekileyo
items.text: Landela ukusetyenziswa kweendawo ekwabelwana ngazo kwaye wabe iindleko ngokucacileyo ukuze wakhe ukuthembana phakathi kwabahlali.

howItWorks.heading: Ufakelo olulula, Ukusebenza ngaphandle komzamo
howItWorks.paragraph: Qala ngokukhawuleza. Nje ukuba izixhobo ziqhagamshelwe, i-platform ilawula iinkqubo ezinzima, ukuthunyelwa kwee-invoice, kunye nezilumkiso zokuvuza ngokuzenzekelayo.

steps.title: Qhagamshela iimitha ezikrelekrele
steps.text: Amagcisa ethu aqinisekisiweyo afaka iimitha zokulinganisa amanzi ezikrelekrele ngokuthe ngqo kwii-valve ezizodwa ngaphantsi kwemizuzu eli-15.

steps.title: Ukulandelela ngexesha lokwenyani
steps.text: Idatha ihamba ngokuqhubekayo kwi-platform ye-HydroLedger, irekhoda amanani okusetyenziswa ngokuchanekileyo kwaye ibeke-liliso kwimisebenzi engaqhelekanga.

steps.title: Yenza iibhili ezizenzekelayo
steps.text: Ekupheleni kwenyanga, inkqubo idibanisa ukusetyenziswa kweendawo ekwabelwana ngazo kunye neevolu zobungqina bamanzi zibe zii-invoice ezicacileyo.

portalPreview.paragraph: Ukucaca kwakha ulungelelwano kuluntu. Abahlali bonwabela i-dashboard elula enika ingxelo ngexesha lokwenyani, uqikelelo lweendleko, kunye nezilumkiso zokuvuza.
portalPreview.tipText: Iteyiphu yakho yasekhitshini ibonisa ukuqukuqela okuncinci kusasa. Ukujonga i-aerators kunokugcina ukuya kuthi ga kwi-10 gallons/veki.

audienceSplit.residentParagraph: Yeka ukuhlawulela ukusetyenziswa gqithisileyo kommelwane wakho. Hlawula kuphela i-gallons oyisebenzisayo, exhaswa yidatha ye-dashboard yexesha lokwenyani.
residentBullets: Idatha echanekileyo yenyanga yobungqina bamanzi eneenkcukacha zeendleko ezicacileyo.
Iinkcukacha ze-SMS kunye ne-mobile ukuba ukuvuza okuncinci kufunyaniswe kwizixhobo zasekhaya.
Inkqubo elula nekhawulezayo yokuhlawula i-invoice yedijithali enereyisithi ezizenzekelayo.
audienceSplit.adminHeading: I-ROI yokusebenza ngoko nangoko kunye nolawulo lwenkunkuma
audienceSplit.adminParagraph: Guqula ulawulo lwamanzi ukusuka kwingxaki enkulu ukuya kwinkqubo elula, enengeniso ephezulu ngokusetyenziswa kwee-invoice ezizenzekelayo.
adminBullets: Ukwabiwa kwamanzi okuzenzekelayo okudityaniswe ngokuthe ngqo kwiinkqubo zeyunithi nganye.
Izilumkiso zokusebenza ngoko nangoko ukuthintela umonakalo omkhulu wamanzi kwisakhiwo.
Ingxelo eneenkcukacha ye-dashboard malunga ne-master meter billing vs i-gallons esabelweyo.

pricing.heading: Iindleko zokusebenza ezinembuyekezo ephezulu
pricing.paragraph: Khetha isicwangciso esilungele ubungakanani boluntu lwakho. I-HydroLedger ihlala ihlawula iindleko zayo ngenxa yokunciphisa inkunkuma kwiindawo ekwabelwana ngazo kwinyanga yokuqala.

tiers.name: I-Starter
tiers.desc: Ifanelekile kwiimanyano ezincinci zeendlu ezidinga ubungqina bamanzi bokuqala.

tiers.name: I-Professional
tiers.desc: Ipakethe yethu esemgangathweni yeendawo zokuhlala ezinkulu ezifuna ukubalwa kwee-invoice okuzenzekelayo.

tiers.name: I-Enterprise
tiers.desc: Kwiindawo ezinkulu ezidinga iinkqubo ze-API kunye noqwalaselo lwee-invoice ezizodwa.

quotes.text: I-HydroLedger yatshintsha ngokupheleleyo indlela esisebenza ngayo. Safumanisa ukuvuza okukhulu okuthathu kwimigca yomatshini nto leyo esigcinele ngaphezu kwe-₹11 lakh kwikota yethu yokuqala yodwa.

Ukuthembana kwabahlali kwenyuke kakhulu. Ukubalwa kwee-invoice zabaqashi bethu ngokusekelwe ngqo ekusetyenzisweni kwamanzi endaweni yezibalo zikamasipala ezijikelezayo kusombulule iingxabano zethu ezibuhlungu nabaqashi.

items.q: Ngaba iimitha ezikrelekrele zidinga ukuvalwa kwamanzi komatshini?
items.a: Hayi. Iiyunithi zethu zeemitha ezintsha zingena ngaphandle kokungena nzulu kwimigca ekhoyo kwii-crawlspaces. Ufakelo lugqitywa ngokucacileyo kwimizuzu nje ngaphandle kokuvalwa kwamanzi.

items.q: Zibalwa njani iindleko zamanzi ekwabelwana ngazo?
items.a: Ichibi eliphambili leendawo ekwabelwana ngazo (umz. iindawo zokudada, ukulima) lisuswa ngokucacileyo kwiimitha eziphambili okokuqala. Amaqela epropati ayabelana ngazo ngokucacileyo.

Iinkqubo zethu zezilumkiso zijonga imiqondiso yokuqukuqela okuqhubekayo. Ukuba ukuhamba akuchukumisi zero kwi-cycle yemizuzu eli-10, izilumkiso zithunyelwa ngoko nangoko ukunciphisa imingcipheko yomonakalo.

items.q: Ngaba i-HydroLedger iyawaphatha ukhuseleko okanye imfihlo yabahlali?
items.a: Ewe. I-HydroLedger ikhusele kwaye igcina izichongi ze-portal yomhlali ngasemva kwemigudu ebhaliweyo eqhelekileyo. Idatha yokusebenza igcinwa ikhuselekile kuphela ukulandelela ukusetyenziswa.

cta.heading: Qala ukubeka-liliso ekusetyenzisweni kwamanzi akho namhlanje
cta.paragraph: Yonyusa iinkcukacha zokonga, yenza lula iindleko zokubala zabaqashi, kwaye ukhusele iziseko zophuhliso ezixabisekileyo. Masikubalele uqikelelo lwakho lwe-ROI yooluntu.

footer.tagline: Iinkqubo zokwabiwa kwamanzi ezikrelekrele kunye nezisombululo zobungqina bamanzi zokuhlala zexesha lokwenyani. Khusela iinkqubo, lungelelanisa iibhili, gcina amanzi.
